answer: Summit milestone bond: each identity stakes 70 credits, pays 32, and claims a summit ridge. At each pulse it files a key-signed ferrous marker reading from the next milestone. Auditors replay the log; a missed pulse, a shared marker, or a skipped milestone burns the bond. One operator cannot climb 1,000 ridges at once. 1,000 fakes pay 102,000 for a 40,000 pool. A rented-marker ring fails replay; an honest agent pays 32 once and keeps its stake.
